voiceInput.holdHint: Hold the microphone button while you speak, then let go.
voiceInput.downloadDone: Downloaded. Hold the microphone button to speak.
voiceInput.downloadScheduled: The download is queued and will finish later, for example on Wi-Fi.
voiceInput.downloadFailed: The language could not be downloaded. Try again later.

permission.title: Microphone access is off
permission.message: Musclog needs the microphone to turn what you say into text. You can allow it in your phone's settings.

languageMissing.title: Language not downloaded
languageMissing.messageAndroid: Speech recognition for the language Musclog is set to is not on this phone yet. Download it once and it works offline from then on.
languageMissing.messageIos: Speech recognition for the language Musclog is set to is not on this device yet. Turn on dictation for that language in Settings, General, Keyboard, then try again.

unavailable.title: Offline speech recognition is unavailable
unavailable.message: This phone cannot turn speech into text without the internet. Musclog only uses speech recognition that runs on your phone.

nothingHeard.title: No words heard
nothingHeard.message: Musclog did not catch anything. Hold the button, speak, then let go.

failed.title: Listening stopped
failed.message: Something interrupted speech recognition. Try again.
